payload.posture: Read Numbers 1:1–4 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: A census begins in Sinai’s wilderness belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
